title: Domain
description: A vocabulary: the entities and relationships of one subject, versioned together. uses names other domains whose entities this one may refer to. It names a vocabulary, never an organization. Three firms in one deal share a parties vocabulary and differ by instances of organization. A domain is not a tenant and not a database. Actions, rules, effects, and workflows are not part of this schema.

dna.description: The structure vocabulary this document is written in.

id.description: Stable id of this vocabulary. Other domains name it from uses.

uses.description: Other domains whose entities this one refers to. Each item is a domain id. An organization is an instance in a parties domain, not an entry here.

entities.description: The kinds of thing in this vocabulary.

relationships.description: The edges between those entities, including edges into domains named by uses.

extensions.description: Entities of domains named by uses that this domain extends with attributes of its own. An entity has one owning domain, which keeps its attributes, its states and its Actions. An extension adds beside them and never changes them. This domain's behaviour document may declare Actions on an extended entity, and those Actions change only this extension's attributes. To change the owner's attributes or state, an Operation applies an Action the owner declares.

extension.description: One entity of another domain, extended by this one. Records of that entity carry these attributes under this domain's extension.

entity.description: domain/entity: an entity declared in a domain named by uses. A domain extends an entity at most once.

description.description: Why this domain extends the entity.

attributes.description: The attributes this domain adds. A name repeats none of the owner's attributes and none of another extension's on the same entity. None is a state attribute: the owner's state moves only through the owner's Actions.
